description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Earth 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Limit Combo Follow-Up] and Earth Limit Form +1 to the user

description.name: Attach Earth 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Limit Combo Follow-Up
description.text: Grants Earth Limit Form +1 after using Grand Break two times, removed if user hasn't [Synchro Mode]
